After PURCOPYing a symbol, the impure SY2 blocks were never freed for reuse.
The garbage collector doesn't sweep any SY2 segments. Now PURCOPY explicitly
adds the old SY2 block to the SY2 freelist, and the SY2 segments are still
not swept.
